reason: Changes which guide files are copied and the exact agent prompt, with new major-version logic and file copying that can fail at runtime.
risk_signals: filesystem copy of docs into temp dir
headline: Upgrade agent now gets per-scenario guides chosen by major-version crossing
summary: spawnNextUpgrade now picks a different-major, same-major or future-defaults guide, copies only the needed docs (shared.md, codemods, version-N.md) to the temp dir, and runs the codemod only when a major is crossed. The prompt now points the agent at shared.md first and appends a future-defaults guide step for the future policy.
focus: every version-N.md between installed and target majors exists in the bundled docs under the router dir chosen by version < 14, since a missing file makes cp throw
same-major updates no longer run the codemod or write the codemod guide; confirm that is intended for security and latest policies
future policy prompt for needsVersionUpdate with no pending defaults, and the futureGuidePath copy for the same-major and different-major cases
major() on installedVersion/targetVersion, including canary or prerelease strings
